numeric_semantics: complex amplitudes represented as pairs of Python Fraction values; irrational and trigonometric coefficients are deterministically rationalized by the qasm_matrix implementation, including 1/sqrt(2), so exact equality is exact only within that encoded rational model
notes: Canonical Python unitary profile. q[i] is basis-index bit weight 2^i (LSB). Exactly one vector qubit register named q is accepted. Hadamard is normalized by the interpreter's deterministic rational approximation to 1/sqrt(2). Includes are skipped syntactically and are not library-semantic imports. This profile is distinct from legacy unitary.v1 and does not reinterpret historical evidence.
